questions.question:
Match historical movements to the source's printed years: (a) Santhal Rebellion; (b) Maplah Rebellion; (c) Vizag Revolution; (d) Bardoli Satyagraha.
1 1923; 2 1929; 3 1921; 4 1855. Choose a–d.

text.en:
Match historical movements to the source's printed years: (a) Santhal Rebellion; (b) Maplah Rebellion; (c) Vizag Revolution; (d) Bardoli Satyagraha.
1 1923; 2 1929; 3 1921; 4 1855. Choose a–d.

questions.sourceCaution: HISTORICAL ERROR IN ORIGINAL: the printed matching table assigns Bardoli Satyagraha to 1929, while the well-documented Bardoli Satyagraha occurred in 1928. TNPSC's final key lists C, but because its Bardoli pairing is historically erroneous, this adaptation stays playable and ungraded. Independent reference: Government of India, PIB (2016), Bardoli movement 1928.

questions.question:
Match the source historical figures to its printed roles: (a) Dupleix; (b) Anwar-ud-din; (c) Shuja-ud-Daula; (d) Pocock.
1 Nawab of Bengal; 2 British Admiral; 3 French Governor; 4 Nawab of Carnatic.

text.en:
Match the source historical figures to its printed roles: (a) Dupleix; (b) Anwar-ud-din; (c) Shuja-ud-Daula; (d) Pocock.
1 Nawab of Bengal; 2 British Admiral; 3 French Governor; 4 Nawab of Carnatic.

questions.sourceCaution: HISTORICAL ERROR IN ORIGINAL: the printed role 'Nawab of Bengal' is paired with Shuja-ud-Daula, who was in fact Nawab of Awadh (Oudh). TNPSC's final-key C relies on this inaccurate pairing; do not grade the adapted question. Reference: Government of Uttar Pradesh, Lucknow District, Nawabs of Lucknow.

questions.question: Whom does the original 2015 booklet identify as having bestowed the title 'Sardar' upon Vallabhbhai Patel?

text.en: Whom does the original 2015 booklet identify as having bestowed the title 'Sardar' upon Vallabhbhai Patel?

questions.sourceCaution: HISTORICAL ATTRIBUTION DISPUTE: TNPSC's final key marks C (Mahatma Gandhi), but contemporary accounts, Government of India publications and historians attribute the 'Sardar' title to the people/farmers of Bardoli, including women of Bardoli, after the 1928 movement. Some teaching sources credit Gandhi acting on their behalf. Since the printed options omit Bardoli citizens, no grade is awarded here.

questions.question: Choose the incorrect historical statement as printed in TNPSC Group I 2015.

options.A: Veerappa, Zamindar of Koppal, rose against the Nizam of Hyderabad in 1819
options.B: Gadkaris were military classes that garrisoned Maratha forts
options.C: Chakra Bisoi was a Khond leader
options.D: Sidhu and Kanhu were leaders of the Kols

text.en: Choose the incorrect historical statement as printed in TNPSC Group I 2015.

en.A: Veerappa, Zamindar of Koppal, rose against the Nizam of Hyderabad in 1819
en.B: Gadkaris were military classes that garrisoned Maratha forts
en.C: Chakra Bisoi was a Khond leader
en.D: Sidhu and Kanhu were leaders of the Kols

questions.sourceCaution: Sidhu and Kanhu are historically associated with the Santhal Hul, not the Kol uprising. Names in the study wording are normalised from the source spellings without changing the A–D order.
